user.title: Connect to ChargeSentry
user.description: Create an API key in the ChargeSentry app under Account → API keys, then enter it together with the serial number of the charger you want to add.

data_description.token: A bearer token from Account → API keys. It is only shown once, when the key is created.
data_description.serial: The charger's serial number, for example CS-0001.
data_description.base_url: Only change this if you run ChargeSentry against a different API host.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect ChargeSentry
reauth_confirm.description: The stored API token for {serial} is no longer accepted. Enter a new one.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure ChargeSentry
reconfigure.description: Update the token, serial or API host for this charger.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the ChargeSentry API. Check the base URL and your internet connection.
error.invalid_auth: The API token was rejected. Create a new key in the app and try again.
error.not_admin: This account can see the charger but does not administer it. The live feed is only available to the charger's owner or a site/charger admin.
error.unknown_serial: No charger with that serial number was found.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This charger is already set up.
abort.wrong_charger: That serial belongs to a different charger than the one being reconfigured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the ChargeSentry API, in seconds. Lower values give a more responsive dashboard at the cost of more API calls.

start_charge.name: Start charge
start_charge.description: Remotely starts a charge on a connector.

connector.name: Connector
connector.description: Connector to start. Defaults to the connector the live feed is reporting on.

limit_kwh.name: Energy limit
limit_kwh.description: Stop the session after this many kWh. Leave empty for an unlimited session.

stop_charge.name: Stop charge
stop_charge.description: Remotely stops the charge in progress on a connector.

connector.name: Connector
connector.description: Connector to stop. Defaults to the connector the live feed is reporting on.

delay_start.name: Delay start
delay_start.description: Arms a delayed charge on a connector the vehicle is already plugged into. The charger must be in the Preparing state.

delay_seconds.name: Delay
delay_seconds.description: How long to wait before starting, in seconds (1-86400).

run_for_seconds.name: Run for
run_for_seconds.description: Stop the charge this long after it actually starts, in seconds. Leave empty to run until unplugged.

connector.name: Connector
connector.description: Connector to arm. Defaults to the connector the live feed is reporting on.

limit_kwh.name: Energy limit
limit_kwh.description: Stop the session after this many kWh. Leave empty for an unlimited session.

cancel_delay.name: Cancel delayed charge
cancel_delay.description: Cancels a delayed charge that has not started yet. Use Stop charge to end one that has already begun.

connector.name: Connector
connector.description: Connector to cancel. Defaults to the connector the live feed is reporting on.
